body: ACCEPT the D10 playback amendment. Section 11 now adds a non-scientific runtime playback binding: portable packets carry immutable admitted identities/dispositions and no media locator; the runtime envelope carries the opaque handle, current authorization, and playback capabilities; secrets and local paths never enter view or saved-state artifacts; credential rotation for identical admitted bytes preserves scientific identity; different edition/rendition/stream/checksum refuses; PlaybackUnavailable leaves evidence and horizon intact; alternate-cut substitution is forbidden. All five courts are explicit, StoryAtlas owns browser handle/media control, and storymodel4s may define only the identity/refusal seam if separately authorized.
